summary: End-to-end backend + frontend validation for GngWar after refactor + backend wiring. All 11 pytest backend tests pass (auth register/login/me/logout, duplicate-email 409, bad-password 401, admin seeded, booking anonymous + validation, authenticated booking associates user_id, /bookings/me returns own, non-admin 403, admin 200). Full UI flow verified via Playwright: 12 service cards render, per-card duration switching updates price + strikethrough correctly (30→₹75/₹86, 45→₹112.5/₹129, 60→₹150/₹173), card Book Now pre-selects service+duration in modal, duration change in modal updates total (120→₹300/₹345), navbar Book Now opens modal without service and shows friendly error when submitted without picking one, booking submit creates booking and shows BOOKING CONFIRMED screen, register flow closes modal + shows user pill in navbar, logout returns Login button.

issues: Team-photo placeholder has two layers of instructional text overlapping (SVG label + h3 label + caption) making the hero look cluttered. This is expected because user hasn't provided a photo yet, but consider a single clean placeholder tile.

critical_code_review_comments: server.py get_current_user is invoked manually inside create_booking to attempt optional auth — works but bypasses FastAPI's dependency system; consider a dedicated optional_user dependency for consistency.
CORS_ORIGINS env is read but not used; only FRONTEND_URL is honored. The dead branch in server.py L315-317 should be removed or CORS_ORIGINS wired in.
ADMIN_PASSWORD defaults to 'admin123' if env missing — acceptable for MVP but flag for production hardening.
Bookings /bookings/me limits to 200 and /bookings admin to 500 with no pagination — acceptable for MVP; add pagination when volume grows.
test_credentials: admin@gngwar.com / Admin@GngWar2026 (seeded, verified). New test customers created per-run with TEST_ prefix.
seed_data_creation: Each test run creates fresh TEST_<uuid>@test.com users and one Laundry booking via UI flow. No cleanup performed (safe — prefixed).
context_for_next_testing_agent: Backend pytest suite lives at /app/backend/tests/backend_test.py — 11 tests covering auth + bookings, all passing against external URL. UI test IDs used: navbar-book-button, hero-book-button, book-service-<slug>, duration-select-<slug>, card-price-<slug>, booking-modal, booking-service-select, booking-duration-select, booking-total-price, booking-name-input, booking-mobile-input, booking-address-input, booking-date-input, booking-time-select, continue-booking-button, booking-confirmation, navbar-login-button, auth-*-input, auth-submit-button, switch-to-register, navbar-user-pill, navbar-logout-button.
rca of the issue: N/A — no failing tests. One test-side fix applied: backend lowercases emails during register/login, so the pytest was updated to compare emails case-insensitively.
